case_name: Monika Alias Vijay vs Vishnu Sharma

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Monika @ Vijay W/o Shri Vishnu Sharma D/o Shri Ramesh Waka, By Caste Brahmin, R/o At Present Village Baswa, Police Station Baswa, Disict Dausa Raj. (wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: Vishnu Sharma S/o Shri Radharman Sharma, By Caste Brahmin, R/o Village Akhegarh, Tehsil And Police Station Nadabai, District Bharatpur Raj. (husband)

facts_of_case: Petitioner wife has filed case under Section 498-A I.P.C. before the Court at Dausa. An application under Section 125 (3) Cr.P.C. is pending before the Family Court, Dausa.

legal_principles.principle: Proceedings should be transferred to a court where other related proceedings are pending.
legal_principles.held: In view of the fact that proceedings under Section 498-A I.P.C. & 125 (3) of Cr.P.C. is pending at Dausa, it would be proper to transfer the Case No.220/2015 pending before District Judge, Bharatpur to Family Court, Dausa.

legal_principles.principle: It is in the interest of both parties to have related applications heard together.

outcome.final_order: Application No.220/2015 pending before District Judge, Bharatpur is transferred to Family Court, Dausa. Both parties shall remain present before the Family Court, Dausa on 18.04.2019.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer application under Section 13A of the Hindu Marriage Act
